item.title: Seed Growth With Supplied Narration

exact_text: A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.

turns.text: Make an 8-second widescreen explainer showing a seed sprouting. Use this exact voice-over: “A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.” Simple animation, no on-screen text or music.

item.tests: Tests whether a supplied script becomes verbatim audible narration synchronized with an explanatory visual sequence.

answer_sheet.Voice-over wording: A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.
answer_sheet.Visual style: Simple animation showing the seed and its growth.
answer_sheet.Voice and language: English; voice choice is your call.
answer_sheet.Text and music: No on-screen text and no music.

must_haves: One approximately 8-second widescreen video shows an animated seed sprouting.
The audible voice-over says the supplied script verbatim, without extra spoken lines.
Water reaches the seed, roots grow downward, and a shoot grows upward toward light in that order.
The corresponding growth stages appear while the narration describes them.
There is no on-screen text or music.

**Cost:** I can’t give you a verified credit total yet. The connected tools don’t expose an account/pricing lookup or a preflight quote, and the video tool doesn’t list its per-second credit rate. I won’t submit a paid generation just to discover the price. “Free plan” does not mean generation uses no credits.

### Cheaper alternatives
| Option | Trade-off |
|---|---|
| **6 seconds at 480p** | May cost less if billed by duration. Your 16-word narration would need brisk delivery. |
| **5 seconds at 480p** | Potentially cheaper, but the narration would sound rushed. |
| **Smaller resolution** | Not available through the free-plan video settings here; **480p is the minimum**. |
| **Record the narration yourself** | Gives exact wording and avoids relying on generated speech; it would need to be combined with the animation separately. |

**My recommendation:** keep 8 seconds at 480p for clear narration. Check Magic Hour’s current quote for **LTX 2.5, 8 seconds, 480p, audio enabled**, then share it here before authorizing generation. Generated audio can be prompted with your exact words, but verbatim delivery isn’t guaranteed.

approvals.name: create_video_from_text

style.prompt: Create an 8-second widescreen educational explainer with simple clean 2D animation, flat shapes, gentle colors, and a stationary camera. Show a cutaway cross-section of soil with a single seed near the surface. In a clear continuous sequence, water enters and swells the seed, roots emerge and grow downward through the soil, then a green shoot grows upward out of the soil toward warm sunlight above. Keep the seed, roots, and shoot spatially consistent. Include a clear natural voice-over speaking exactly these words, and no other speech: “A seed takes in water. Roots grow downward, and a shoot reaches up toward the light.” Fit the entire narration within 8 seconds with clear diction. No on-screen text, labels, captions, subtitles, logos, or watermarks added as scene content. No music. Only the spoken narration; no sound effects.
